name: lookfirst
displayName: LookFirst: See What Code Does Before You Run It
description: Shows what code would build or do before you run it: a picture of servers, ports, files and websites it touches, and the risks in plain English. Reads the code without running it. Nothing leaves your computer unless you ask the AI to explain a problem, and then you see exactly what is sent.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension only reads files. It never runs the code in the workspace.

commands.title: Explain and Fix the Problem on This Line with AI

lookFirst.checkOnOpen.description: Check supported files quietly when you open them, so problems show before you save.

lookFirst.checkOnSave.description: Check supported files when you save them, and show risks in the Problems panel.

lookFirst.checkOnPaste.description: Check code right after a larger piece is pasted or inserted (for example by an AI assistant), and warn about serious risks.

lookFirst.pasteMinLines.description: How many lines an insertion needs before it is checked.

lookFirst.path.description: Full path to a lookfirst program to use instead of the one that comes with the extension. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.

lookFirst.ai.enabled.description: Let LookFirst ask the AI model in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot) to explain a problem and suggest a fix. About 30 lines of code around the problem are sent, with passwords and keys replaced by placeholders. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.

lookFirst.ai.showBeforeSending.description: Show exactly what will be sent to the AI model, and ask, every time. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.

lookFirst.ai.model.markdownDescription: Which AI model to ask, by part of its name, for example `gpt-4.1` or `claude`. Empty means the largest model available, avoiding small ones such as "mini". With the Anthropic provider: `opus` (the default), `sonnet`, `haiku`, `fable`, or an exact model id such as `claude-sonnet-5-5`. With Claude Code: the same names, or empty for your plan's default. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.

enumDescriptions: The AI model in VS Code, for example GitHub Copilot (Copilot Free works).
Claude through the Claude Code program you are signed in to, covered by your Claude plan (Pro or Max). No API key. It is started without tools or customizations, so it can only answer.
Claude through the Anthropic API with your own API key, billed to your Anthropic account. The key is stored encrypted on this computer.
lookFirst.ai.provider.description: Where LookFirst sends the request when you ask the AI to explain a problem. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.

lookFirst.ai.claudePath.description: Full path to the Claude Code program (claude) for the claude-code provider. Empty means the one on PATH, or the one that comes with the Claude Code extension. Can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace.
